meta.parties: The Imperial Bank of India, Ltd. v. Perera Et Al

rules.statement: A District Court in the course of testamentary proceedings is not competent to compel a Bank to deposit money lying to the credit of a deceased customer whose estate is being administered.
rules.supporting_quote: It is not competent for a District Court in the course of testamentary proceedings to compel a Bank to: deposit in Court money lying to the credit of the deceased testator, whose estate is being administered.
